how_lead: No more dragging Maps around hoping for the good stuff. Tell ApexRoute what you want, get a route built around it, drive.
steps: Distance, twistiness, scenery. ApexRoute uses your starting point and finds roads that match — not the fastest, the best.
Live in-app navigation, with corner counts, gradient previews, and a heads-up display that doesn't shout at you.
Every drive recorded with route, telemetry, and notes. Replay it, share it, beat your own line next time.

why_head_pre: The road is half the car.
why_head_accent: ApexRoute makes the half worth chasing.
why_lead: Most maps optimise for arriving. ApexRoute optimises for the drive — the corners, the rhythm, the road that makes you stop the playlist and just listen to the engine.
why_body: Three years in, our routes have been driven across the UK, the Alps, the Dolomites, Big Sur, and the Tail of the Dragon. The algorithm gets sharper every drive.
stats: Route choices controlled by you — no sponsored detours, no hidden cost.
From input to a brand-new route. Faster than checking your phone at lights.
Maps download once. Your drive doesn't depend on cellular signal.
faq: For commuting, no — Maps wins on traffic. For weekend drives, yes. ApexRoute is built around the kind of road you'd take a longer way to find.

If your country has real road data we cover it: UK, Ireland, France, Germany, Switzerland, Italy, Spain, Austria, Netherlands, Belgium, Norway, Sweden, plus the US, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.
Recording happens on your phone. Telemetry stays private until you choose to share. You can delete any drive in one tap.
What about traffic, road closures, fuel?
Plus shows live traffic on your route plus fuel stops and rest points. We surface what matters; we don't drown you in clutter.
Can I import a route I made elsewhere?
Yes — GPX import is supported. Drive it, rate it, get your telemetry alongside it.
Is this safe to use while driving?
Heads-up navigation is voice + glanceable visuals only. We won't bury anything important behind a tap. Eyes on the road, always.
Cancel any time in your phone's subscription settings — Apple ID or Google Play. We don't pull dark patterns.
final_body: Free to download. Free to try. iPhone and Android. Your next great road is one tap away.
